name: aipe
description: Spec workflow for AI-assisted development. 39 disciplined slash commands across three flows — action (Describe → Diagnose → Act), reflective (Evaluate, Teach + Rehearse + Read), and readiness (Recon → Drill). Four orchestrators that run their families in one pass. Study family (1 orchestrator + 17 generators): /aipe:study, /aipe:study-system-design, /aipe:study-software-design, /aipe:study-frontend-engineering, /aipe:study-data-modeling, /aipe:study-nonfunctional-requirements (cross-cutting NFR audit — reliability, scalability, maintainability, latency, availability, security, observability, cost — framed per DDIA 2e Ch 2; cross-links to deep-walk siblings), /aipe:study-security, /aipe:study-testing, /aipe:study-runtime-systems, /aipe:study-networking, /aipe:study-database-systems, /aipe:study-dsa-foundations, /aipe:study-distributed-systems, /aipe:study-debugging-observability, /aipe:study-performance-engineering, /aipe:study-ai-engineering, /aipe:study-agent-architecture, /aipe:study-prompt-engineering. Rehearse family (1 orchestrator + 5 generators): /aipe:rehearse, /aipe:rehearse-problem-selection, /aipe:rehearse-design-doc, /aipe:rehearse-hackathon-demo, /aipe:rehearse-interview-defense, /aipe:rehearse-eval-workshop (10-exercise coached workshop for building trustworthy evals on your codebase; human-owned labels are the anchor, AI drafts plumbing but never labels; inside /aipe:rehearse the workbook is generated but coaching happens later via standalone invocation). Plus /aipe:rehearse-behavioral-stories — a per-person STAR story bank for FAANG-style behavioral loops; standalone, not in the rehearse fan-out. Readiness family (1 orchestrator + 2 generators): /aipe:ready, /aipe:recon, /aipe:drill — measures hireability on the AI-engineering ladder and closes the highest-leverage gap with a hands-on failure-rep. Audit family (1 orchestrator + 5 generators): /aipe:audit, /aipe:audit-status, /aipe:audit-cleanup, /aipe:audit-frontend-a11y, /aipe:audit-refactor, /aipe:audit-software-design — take stock of a project (what is, what's wrong, what's inaccessible, what an engineer would say, what design principles are violated). Plus /aipe:refactor (+ 2 refactor variants), /aipe:read-aposd, and /aipe:code-review for per-branch PR reviews. Uses your agent's own model, no external CLI, no extra API keys.
